snippet.title: Carp, Carp, Magikarp - Reel Fishing II Part 1
snippet.description:
http://www.emulator-zone.com/doc.php/psx/

http://coolrom.com/roms/psx/40103/Reel_Fishing_II.php


Reel Fishing Part 1

Part 1 of a multi-part series that I'll make during my free time, which I definitely have a lot of right now.

In this episode, we try to catch some deep-bodied Crucian Carp. I know it is not the first level that is offered in the game, but I consider it the first level. I will eventually go back to the Variety Fishing area, but for now, I have to find that foot-long Crucian Carp! AKA Golden Magikarp

If you are not familiar with the game, Reel Fishing II is a PlayStation game in which you catch different types of fish (obviously) and in order to progress into different levels of the game, you have to meet certain objectives, possibly catching multiple fish in a certain area, or catching a giant! As you progress, the game gets harder. You may ask, how can catching one fish be harder than catching some other fish? Well some fish you need to strike right away but others you must wait a bit. Some fish require certain bait, different methods of fishing, etc. It's all trial and error.

It's not a very intense game, but I find it rather enjoyable and I hope you do too as you join me on my quest to catch all 70 fish in Reel Fishing II ! Gotta Catch 'em All!
